title: Single-Story Home, Fenced Yard & Firepit, 5 Min DT
description:
Located 5 minutes from downtown, this single-level 3-bedroom and 2-bathroom home is the perfect spot for a family trip! This home can accommodate up to 8 guests.

HIGHLIGHTS
- 3 Bedrooms w/ Queen-sized beds 
- Fenced-In Backyard w/ Firepit
- No Chores upon Departure
- Kitchen & Bathroom Essentials
- One Parking Spot in Driveway
- Washer & Dryer w/ Tide Pods
- Free WiFi
- Bag Drop Off, Early Check-In & Late Check-Out Options
- Smart Lock w/ Unique Access Code

The space
This single-story home features 3 bedrooms, each with a queen-sized bed and a smart TV, and 2 bathrooms. The living room couch converts into a full-sized bed. The house is accessible via steps leading to the front door. The backyard is fully fenced, making it ideal for pets. The home also includes a combination washer and dryer unit. Parking is available in the driveway for one vehicle, with additional free street parking available.

Guest access
Guests will have access to the entire home. They'll receive a four-digit access code before arrival to enter the unit through our Schlage Encode smart lock. Additionally, there will be an onsite lockbox accessible in case of a smart lock failure. We provide 24/7 customer support to ensure you never get locked out.

Other things to note
We are the following minutes away from these destinations by car:
- 2 minutes from Tennessee State Museum, Bicentennial Capitol Mall State Park & Nashville Farmers' Market
- 5 minutes from Broadway, Ryman Auditorium, Nissan Stadium & Bridgestone Arena
- 15 minutes from Grand Ole Opry & Opry Mills Mall
- 15 minutes from the Nashville International Airport (BNA)
- 10 minutes from Geodis Park (Home to Nashville SC)
- 10 minutes from Belmont University
- 8 minutes from Vanderbilt University
